description.zh: 是否允许跳过失败节点，默认值为False
description.en: Specifies whether to skip failed nodes. Default value: False.

description.zh: 是否支持文件系统挂载
description.en: Specifies whether file system mounting is supported.

description.zh:
节点 RAM 角色名称。您可以使用 RAM API ListRoles 查询您已创建的节点 RAM 角色。设置的角色的信任主体必须为“智能计算灵骏”。
注意：当前暂不支持将已有角色清空。
description.en:
The RAM role name of the node. You can call the RAM API ListRoles to query the node RAM roles that you have created. The trusted entity of the specified role must be set to Lingjun AI Computing Service.
Note: Clearing an existing role is not supported.

description.zh: 自定义可执行shell脚本，需要以 Base64 方式编码，原始数据最多为 16 KB。
description.en: The custom executable shell script. The script must be Base64-encoded. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB.
Specifies whether to enable GPU splitting.

description.zh: 网络接口是否支持巨帧
description.en: Specifies whether the network interface supports jumbo frames.
